Welcome to this immaculate, custom-built West Norwalk ranch, where thoughtful design, quality craftsmanship, & easy living come together in a peaceful fully fenced park-like setting. This beautiful home w/ a lovely stone fence along the street frontage has been lovingly maintained & thoughtfully improved. The open main level features vaulted ceiling & skylights, creating a bright & spacious feeling. The eat-in kitchen has a breakfast bar, dining area, & direct access to the 2-car garage. It opens to the inviting family room with a floor-to-ceiling brick gas fireplace-an ideal setting for relaxed evenings or gathering with friends & family. A formal dining room with tray ceiling offers additional space for holidays & special occasions. Multiple rooms open to the enclosed 3 season porch & deck both overlooking the deep, private yard. It is a wonderful place to enjoy morning coffee, quiet afternoons, or time outdoors from spring through fall. The primary bedroom has direct deck access. The main level includes two bedrooms & full bath. The finished walk-out lower level adds valuable flexibility, with a third bedroom, beautiful full bath, laundry area, & versatile living space suitable for a guest suite, home office, recreation room, or media room.
